detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:03. The shot begins from <Picture 4>: an insert from the corridor, now abreast of the dissecting-room doorway, seen through it: a plain wooden stick lying on a slab beside a body under a grey sheet, cold light from a high window; only what <Picture 4> shows is in frame. The camera is in the middle of the corridor abreast of the dissecting-room doorway, at walking height, a normal lens, turned square into the opening, so the dark jambs of that doorway stand down BOTH edges of frame. The camera pushes in through the doorway toward the slab for the whole shot as the stick and the sheet grow from a third of the frame to two thirds and the doorframe passes out of both edges of frame, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 a drip runs off the slab's edge to the floor, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot.
[Shot 2] From 00:03 to 00:08. At 00:03 the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> stopped dead beside the dissecting-room doorway, beginning from <Picture 5>: bareheaded, dark hair swept back, thin moustache, the brown bowler in the hand on the right of frame, the black stick's silver knob under the bare sunburnt hand on the left of frame, staring in, mouth closed, his face grey-white to the lips; <Subject 2>'s black shoulder at the edge of frame, nearer the camera, soft. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 1> takes a full step back from the doorway on his stick, his whole body moving to the right of frame, from 00:03 to 00:06. At 00:06 his head and shoulders turn round to <Subject 2> at the frame edge, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind them two students in black coats at a dun-coloured door with one open folio between them, and a charwoman at the whitewashed wall with both hands on her zinc pail, from 00:03 to 00:08. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:03 to 00:05 while he takes a full step back from the doorway on his stick.

overall_soundscape: The ambience of a long stone corridor inside Saint Bartholomew's Hospital runs under the whole take: its own air, the surfaces underfoot and the fabric of the room around it. Cloth, boots, wood and glass carry the physical action, and the movement and low murmur of the people at work nearby carry under it throughout.
